prayerExcerpt.en-US: God became man so that man might become God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Deus se fez homem para que o homem se tornasse Deus.

meta.face: An old man around 75, bald on top, a broad full white beard spreading wide over the chest, steadfast resolute expression.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
